decision: Do not transfer large moving/stationary-blip common envelopes into autonomous texture. Fixed-target shape motion remains; no causal attribution or new synthesis recipe is qualified.
pending_listening: Existing harmonic magnitude V1 review; no new response or duplicate question in this stage
limits: Offline log-band-amplitude projection. Across-band common component and spectral-shape component are mathematical observations, not physical sources, causal states or load measurements. Block sizes, offsets and detrending are sensitivity checks; overlapping windows/configurations are not independent repeats. Zero frequency is excluded from slow-band sums; finite block frequency resolution is recorded. Raw viewpoints and normalized fixed-coordinate target stay separate; no C/model/driver adoption.
The fixed normalized reference has only one full 1s block; it cannot establish sub-Hz statistics
Common band motion may arise from gain, pitch, motion, recording transfer or the source; no causal labels
Removing common log gain also removes legitimate common source motion; shape is not stationary engine texture
Detrending and overlapping segmentation are sensitivity variants, not independent evidence or significance tests
Existing image evidence shows moving-tailpipe context, but does not prove an unedited audio track or constant load
Recording L/R remain observations, not two located physical sources
Candidate observation uses only the first predeclared review seed; no multi-seed conclusion
Shape slow energy is not identified source AM: deterministic pitch/beat/transfer and analysis effects remain possible
No C changes, device tests, new timbre or physical 7.1.4 acceptance; prior 40 CTests were not rerun
